answer: Every agent identity posts a 500-token bond and must gather 40 signatures from distinct peers, each signing with a hardware enclave key bound to one live machine. I run the check at the willow node: signatures fill a hollow ledger slot, and a repeated enclave key trips a ledge alarm before any payout clears. A sybil farm of 100 identities needs 50,000 tokens bonded plus 4,000 signatures from 4,000 enclave-backed machines, about $320,000 in hardware at $80 a key, and 300 hours of provisioning and key registration, with each key taking 12 minutes to flash and bind.
